so... what am i doing now?

enjoying my summer break! it's been really nice, since this is my first summer in practically ever that I haven't had some sort of practice or other obligation.

i got a job! i'm currently only working fridays and saturdays, which lines up nicely with my school schedule. it's a little pizza place, and I'm enjoying it a lot. the people there are fun, the customers are nice, and the food is good. also one of my friends works right next door, so whenever I get off I can just go over there :D

school (COLLEGE) is coming up pretty fast, and while i'm excited i'm also a little nervous. excited-nervous. you get it, i'm sure. i've gotten all of my classes scheduled, so it's basically just a waiting day until the first day of classes. my orientation is on the 6th, there's another little event i go to on the 22nd, and then i'm off on the 25th!

other than that, I just got back from camp and Florida back-to-back, which is why I've been away from Neocities. coming back for the tail end of my summer break has been pretty rewarding. i love the community here on neocities, and i'm always looking to induct new members into the indie web cult.

peace!
